quarterly_data.quarter: Hitachi Energy press release: Hitachi Energy develops power system simulation with NVIDIA (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Hitachi Energy announced a new power-system simulation capability with integrated NVIDIA Omniverse libraries (OpenUSD-based workflows), adding to the wider NVIDIA DSX Sim partner ecosystem, that lets data-center teams evaluate how future AI factory power systems may perform before they are built - comparing designs and assessing resilience from the grid to the rack, with an integrated AI assistant for natural-language exploration of the digital twin. The initial use case is power system simulation and resilience assessment for emerging 800 VDC architectures for next-generation AI factories, building on its close collaboration with NVIDIA for 800 VDC AI factories. The release says it follows the recent qualification of Hitachi Energy's battery energy storage system as NVIDIA DSX Ready BESS. Marco Berardi (Head of Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service): as AI factories scale, access to electricity, power system design and the ability to deploy infrastructure at speed are becoming increasingly important.
